google ai overview
Google AI Overviews are AI-generated summaries that appear at the very top of Google Search results to answer a user's query. [[1], [2]]
Key Facts

* Technology: Powered by Google's Gemini large language models. [1]
* Placement: They sit in "position zero" above traditional blue-link organic search results. [[1], [2]]
* Citations: Each overview features inline links and reference cards pointing to the source websites used to build the answer. [[1], [2]]
* Interactivity: Users can click "Show more" or type follow-up questions to transition into a conversational AI mode. [[1], [2]]
* Availability: Launched in the US in May 2024 and expanded globally, they are available across more than 120 countries. [[1], [2], [3]]

How to Bypass or Use Them

* Can you turn them off? There is no default toggle to permanently disable AI Overviews in Google Search settings. [1]
* How to see only links: You can click the Web tab at the top of the search results page to filter out AI summaries and view only standard text links. [1]
* Learn more: Read official details on Google AI Overviews or track the feature's background on [Wikipedia](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVRKplIRW3O3yprSxGveTi7iNWSv6mtTjTmjdh7xRiCVPtEURkqCj-H9bVfriGCbv5VSP24taY0HWOUuQ664_67I5b7xK5BOemVugNRl-vNvhPp7yi5aEbDjYIurYT). [[1], [2]]
